text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spring ended, and the time for summer 
training camp arrived. Aston Machan's 
condition had recovered, her blog's view 
count returned to normal, and things were 
looking great.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's feeling better, the two of 
you will train hard together for the 
Sprinters Stakes!
